body:
A second case of this class, found with the 2D Pocket recipe of #3752 on `testdata/models/fig8.step` (Waterline, Outside containment, Auto and Outside starts):

- After a lift in a level, the next entry is an air entry. Its arc lead runs from the air at y 177 down to y 167.9 at the level depth.
- On its way it crosses the two outer rings that the level cut before (y 171.02 and y 168.02).
- The verifier reports 6 `Crossing` findings (2 on each of the 3 levels). `Crossing` blocks the post, so the fig8 pocket under `CAMCRAFT_PLANNER=new` does not post.
- The lead runs in stock that the rings cleared before, so it is no gouge. But the entry stage proves the lead against its room only, not against the cuts made before it on the level.

The pin `kernel_route::fig8_kernel_pocket_lifts_are_named` (app, `pocket_pass_start`) names this issue and accepts `Crossing` as the one kind that the kernel adds.
